<fidel-display-prefs>

Display settings. A "Display settings" dialog: text size, line spacing, colours, stop motion, thicker focus and an easy-read font.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Low-vision learners, learners with dyslexia, and people sensitive to motion.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

A web page is a document that a browser shows. Headings help screen-reader users jump to the part they need.

ድረ-ገጽ አሳሽ የሚያሳየው ሰነድ ነው።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-display-prefs target="#lesson"></fidel-display-prefs>

Source: player/src/components/b/display-prefs.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-display-prefs>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
targetCSS selectornoneThe content to adjust. Settings are fidel-dp-* classes on those elements and on Fidel components; never on <html> or <body>.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-display-prefs>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-display-prefs-changethe settingsA setting changed.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Escape closes the dialog and focus goes back to "Display settings". Settings apply at once and are remembered.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text 100, 125, 150 or 200 % (text sized in em or %).
  • 1.4.12 Text Spacing: "Wide" spacing; no letter-spacing, for Ethiopic.
  • 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: "Stop motion" stops CSS animation and looping videos in the target.
  • It is not an overlay: it does not try to repair the host page, only changes how accessible content is shown.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
